column1: # Packages in Olymparch's own pacman repo [olymparch]: built from the AUR at a pinned commit, signed in CI.
# Moving a pin is a reviewed change: read the PKGBUILD diff on aur.archlinux.org before committing a new hash.
# Thrustmaster wheels: the -git recipe (the release recipe broke when upstream moved dkms.conf);
# it builds the driver's newest code, only the recipe is pinned
